verses.translation: Ta'. Sin. Mim.
These are the verses of the Clear Book.

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: (O Muhammad), you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.

verses.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ
verses.translation: If We will, We can send down a Sign to them from heaven, so their necks will be humbled to it.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.translation: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.translation: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translation: Do they not look at the earth, how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: "Go to the wrong-doing people,
the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.translation: He said: "My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.

verses.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ
verses.translation: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent, so endow Messengership on Aaron.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.translation: As for me, they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death."

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.translation: He said: "Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Go, then, to Pharaoh and say to him: 'The Lord of the Universe has sent us
that you let the Children of Israel go with us.'"

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: "Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?

verses.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.translation: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed."

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translation: Moses replied: "I committed that act erringly.

verses.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translation: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!"
Pharaoh said: "And who is this Lord of the Universe?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: Moses answered: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them, if you were only to believe."
Pharaoh said to those around him: "Do you hear (what he says)?"
Moses said: "(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore."

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the audience: "This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad."

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translation: Moses continued: "(He is) the Lord of the east and the west, and all between them. If you only had any understanding!"

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: "If you take any god other than me, I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison."
Moses said: "Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: "Then bring it if you are truthful at all."

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold, it was a veritable serpent,

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.translation: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: "Surely this man is a skilled magician

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.translation: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us, what do you advise us?"

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.translation: They said: "Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities
to mobilise all skilled magicians."
So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time
and the people were told: "Will you join the assembly?

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.translation: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph."

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.translation: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we triumph?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.translation: He said: "Yes, you will then become those near-stationed to me."

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.translation: Moses said to them: "Throw down whatever you wish to throw."

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.translation: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the glory of Pharaoh, we shall prevail."

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.translation: Thereafter, Moses threw down his rod and behold, it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.
Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration,
saying: "We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe,
the Lord of Moses and Aaron."

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: "You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you."

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translation: They said: "We do not care, for we are bound to return to our Lord,

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe."

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translation: We revealed to Moses: "Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued."
Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)
saying: "These (Israelites) are only a small band of people
who have certainly provoked our wrath.
But we are a numerous host, ever on guard."
Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs
and their treasures and excellent dwellings.
This happened with them; (but on the other hand), We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.
At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.translation: and when the groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out: "We are overtaken!"

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.translation: Moses said: "Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me."

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: Then We revealed to Moses, (commanding him): "Strike the sea with your rod." Thereupon the sea split up, and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.
We also brought the other party close to the same spot,
and We delivered Moses and his companions, all of them,
then We drowned the others.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
And recount to them the story of Abraham:

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translation: when he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
verses.translation: They answered: "There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy."
He asked: "Do they hear you when you call them
or do they cause you any benefit or harm?"

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.translation: They answered: "No; but we found our forefathers doing so."
Thereupon, Abraham said: "Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping,
you and your forefathers of yore?

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: They are all enemies to me; all, except the Lord of the Universe
Who created me and Who guides me;
Who gives me food and drink,
and Who, when I am ill, heals me;
Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: Who, I hope, will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement."

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: (And then Abraham prayed): "My Lord, endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous,

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.translation: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity,
and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

verses.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translation: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed,
and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.translation: the Day when nothing will avail, neither wealth nor offspring,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success)."
(On that Day) the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing,
and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed,

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translation: and they will be asked: "Where are the gods that you worshipped

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.translation: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you, or even be of any help to themselves?"
Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong, one upon another,
and so too the hosts of Iblis, all of them.
There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):

verses.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: "By Allah, we were surely in clear error
when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.
It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error,
and now we have none to intercede on our behalf,
nor do we have a truly sincere friend.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: If only we could return we would be among the believers."

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
The people of Noah gave the lie to the Messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: "Do you have no fear?
I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;
so fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.
So fear Allah and obey me."
They answered: "Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: Noah said: "What knowledge do I have about their deeds?

verses.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translation: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!
It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.
I am none but a plain warner."

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.translation: They said: "O Noah! If you do not desist, you will certainly become one of the accursed."
He said: "My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.

verses.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me."

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.translation: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark
and drowned the rest.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
The Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: Recall, when their brother Hud said to them: "Have you no fear?
I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
What, you build a monument on every hill merely for fun
and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever,
and when you strike you strike like tyrants?
So fear Allah and obey me.
Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;
Who has provided you with flocks and children
and with gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day."

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.translation: They replied: "It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.
This has been happening all along.
We will not be subjected to any chastisement."

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: "Have you no fear?"
"I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state
amidst gardens and springs
and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?
You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.
Fear Allah and obey me
and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.translation: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right."
They replied: "You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful."

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.translation: Salih said: "This is a she-camel. There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you."
But they hamstrung her and then regretted it.

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: So the chastisement seized them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
The people of Lot rejected the Messengers, branding them liars.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: Recall, when their brother Lot said to them: "Have you no fear?
I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: I seek of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
What, of all creation will you go to (fornicate with) the males,

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.translation: leaving aside those whom Allah has created for you as your mates. Nay, you are a people that has transgressed all limits."

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.translation: They said: "O Lot! If you do not desist, you will be one of those expelled (from our towns)."
He said: "I am one of those who abhor your practice.
My Lord, deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds."
Then We delivered him and all his family
except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
Thereafter, We utterly destroyed the rest,

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translation: and We sent upon them a rain, an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: Recall, when Shuayb said to them: "Have you no fear?
I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

verses.arabic: أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.translation: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people,
weigh with an even balance

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.translation: and do not deliver short, and do not go about creating mischief in the land,
and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations."
They said: "You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched,

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.translation: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful."
Shuayb said: "My Lord knows well all what you do."

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation: Then they branded him a liar, whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them. It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;
which the truthful spirit has carried down
to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah),
(a revelation) in clear Arabic language,
(a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: Is it not a Sign to them - (to wit, the Makkans) - that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?
(But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited (this clear Arabic discourse) to them

verses.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: they would still not have believed in it.
Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.
But when it comes upon them suddenly, taking them unawares,
they say: "Can we be granted some respite?"
Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?
Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years
and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them,

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.translation: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.translation: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners
to admonish them. We have never been unjust.
The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book),
nor does it behove them, nor does it lie in their power.
Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translation: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished,
and warn your nearest kinsmen;

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: and be meek to the believers who follow you.

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: Then if they disobey you say to them: "I am quit of what you do."
And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate,
Who observes you when you rise (to pray)
and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.
He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
verses.translation: O people, shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?
They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin,
on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.
As for poets, only the wayward follow them.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.translation: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley
and say things which they do not act upon,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translation: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much, and when they themselves were subjected to wrong, they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
